approved.en: A US-brokered ceasefire now covers Oleshky and has been extended across the Kherson region, while local ceasefires operate in other frontline cities. Russian forces were blamed for a fire in the Russian city of Lipetsk after a reported Ukrainian strike, and Ukrainian forces recaptured territory, according to President Zelenskiy. President Putin held calls with the leaders of Finland and Norway, discussed Russian history, and faced split opinions among European leaders, while talks about lifting sanctions on a Russian investment fund continued. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

The Israeli election remains deadlocked, with Netanyahu losing a majority and exit polls showing a narrow edge for the opposition amid record turnout. Gaza’s women filmmakers have launched a new academy to turn pain into cinema. A Hebron groom was caught in a military lockdown. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Det israelske valget er fortsatt fastlåst, med Netanyahu som mister flertall og avgangsmeningsmålinger som viser en liten fordel for opposisjonen i en valgturnering med rekorddeltakelse. Gazas kvinnelige filmregissører har startet et nytt akademi for å omforme smerte til film. En brudgom fra Hebron ble fanget i en militær nedstengning. approved.en: Hezbollah explosives seized from two Lebanese trucks have led Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise a thorough investigation while Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, prompting an IDF probe and possible hike restrictions. Qatar has pledged funding for reconstruction in southern Lebanon, announced a massive solar plant project, and its foreign minister called for Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Nord-Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk, og drepte Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som har ført til en IDF-undersøkelse og mulige restriksjoner på høyde. Qatar har lovet finansiering til gjenoppbygging i Sør-Libanon, kunngjort et massivt solkraftprosjekt, og utenriksministeren oppfordret til israelsk tilbaketrekning fra Libanon. approved.en: Iran is urging the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz while Houthi missiles and drones continue striking Saudi oil facilities and airports, prompting the reopening of Riyadh Airport after weeks of disruption. The United States is weighing renewed strikes on Iran, pushing oil prices above $117 a barrel, and Iran’s supreme leader and top security chief discussed war and Hormuz. Nuclear inspectors reported no evidence that Iran repaired US-bombed nuclear sites, and the IAEA called for nuclear inspections. Israel’s election outcome is being watched for its impact on Iran policy. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

USA vurderer nye angrep mot Iran, noe som presser oljeprisen over 117 dollar per fat, og Irans øverste leder og topp sikkerhetssjef diskuterte krig og Hormuz. Kjernefysiske inspektører rapporterte at de ikke fant bevis for at Iran har reparert de av USA bombetede kjernekraftanleggene, og IAEA oppfordret til kjernefysiske inspeksjoner. Israels valgresultat blir fulgt med interesse for hvordan det kan påvirke Irans politikk. 123 kamprelaterte dødsfall har skjedd i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: The Houthis have launched missiles and drones at Saudi targets, striking the Ras Tanura oil refinery, the Saudi Defence Ministry in Riyadh and other strategic sites, while Saudi air defenses have intercepted many of these weapons. A French frigate shot down a missile approaching a Belgian mine hunter in the Red Sea, and Russian satellites have been used to guide Houthi fire at Saudi Arabia. Egypt's parliament has approved military support for Saudi Arabia, and Princess Reema has called for a global campaign to defeat the Iran-backed Houthis. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Et fransk fregatt skjøt ned et missil som nærmet seg en belgisk minerydder i Rødehavet, og russiske satellitter har blitt brukt til å lede houthi-ild mot Saudi-Arabia. Egypts parlament har godkjent militær støtte til Saudi-Arabia, og prinsesse Reema har oppfordret til en global kampanje for å beseire de Iran-støttede houthiene. Konflikten forårsaket 918 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Jordan has carried out additional airstrikes in Syria, saying they hit Islamic State targets linked to a recent church attack that killed nine people, while Syrian authorities report civilian deaths from the raids. Syria has condemned the strikes as a breach of its airspace and an unacceptable violation, and a joint Jordan-Syria security committee is being formed to investigate. Families of civilians killed in the attacks have held funerals, and Jordan says it killed more than 20 Islamic State militants in the operations. The conflict produced 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Jordan har gjennomført ytterligere luftangrep i Syria, og sier at de rammet IS-mål knyttet til et nylig kirkearrest som drepte ni personer, mens syriske myndigheter rapporterer sivile dødsfall fra raidene. Syria har fordømt angrepene som et brudd på deres luftrom og et uakseptabelt brudd på suvereniteten, og et felles sikkerhetsutvalg mellom Jordan og Syria blir opprettet for å undersøke saken. Familier til sivile som ble drept i angrepene har holdt begravelser, og Jordan sier de drepte mer enn 20 IS-militante i operasjonene. Konflikten førte til 2 732 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Iraqi courts have sentenced seven French citizens to lengthy prison terms for Islamic State membership, including six life sentences, while security forces have repeatedly intercepted unidentified drones over Baghdad, with at least one downed by air defenses. Yazidi militia units linked to the PKK are disarming and joining the Iraqi army, and other militia groups have pledged to disarm by mid-2027. Baghdad is engaged in ongoing talks with the Gulf states and Iran on a regional security plan, and the Iraqi prime minister is meeting Jordanian officials to boost trade and energy cooperation. The conflict produced 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Yazidi-militære enheter knyttet til PKK blir avrustet og slutter seg til den irakiske hæren, og andre militsgrupper har lovet å avrustes innen midten av 2027. Bagdad er i pågående samtaler med gulfstatene og Iran om en regional sikkerhetsplan, og Iraks statsminister møter jordanske tjenestemenn for å styrke handel og energisamarbeid. Konflikten førte til 396 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Intensified drone attacks by the Rapid Support Forces have hit Nyala, killing at least 21 people, injuring 40 and knocking out power in southeast Sudan, worsening civilian hardship. The Sudanese Armed Forces and allied militias continue to grind the conflict, while women under siege are increasingly acting as frontline responders to meet basic needs. Hundreds of thousands of Sudanese refugees are now hosted in Chad as the regional humanitarian emergency expands. The United Nations warns of a looming famine risk as the war grinds on, and the conflict caused 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Coordinated cattle raids in Warrup state killed at least 72 people, while a drone strike on a market in Abyei killed at least 73, intensifying violence in South Sudan. President Kiir reshuffled the South Sudan Revenue Authority board, reinstating two commissioners after a cancelled order, and the Bar Association launched a roadmap to improve access to justice. The government partnered with Israel's Gilat to provide nationwide satellite internet and secured a UNESCO world-heritage nomination for the Boma-Bandingilo inscription. Governor Dollar promoted the reintegration of IDPs and returnees, and the U.S. Embassy remembered staff who died supporting South Sudanese people. 2 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Koordinerte kyrieangrep i Warrup-staten drepte minst 72 personer, mens et droneangrep på et marked i Abyei drepte minst 73, og intensiverte volden i Sør-Sudan. President Kiir omorganiserte styret i South Sudan Revenue Authority, og gjeninnsatte to kommisjonærer etter en avbrutt ordre, og Advokatforeningen lanserte en veikart for å forbedre rettstilgangen. Regjeringen inngikk partnerskap med Israels Gilat for å tilby landsdekkende satellittinternett og sikret en UNESCO-verdensarvnominasjon for Boma-Bandingilo-innskrivingen. Guvernør Dollar fremmet reintegrering av internt fordrevne og tilbakevendende, og den amerikanske ambassaden minnet om ansatte som døde mens de støttet det sørsudanske folket. To dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Al-Shabaab continues to launch large-scale attacks on Somali army convoys, including a deadly ambush near Baidoa and mortar shelling in Puntland that killed three civilians and wounded seven. The army reported a major battle near Buurhakaba district with dozens of its soldiers killed, while it also claimed to have killed 75 al-Shabaab fighters in the same area. Somalia denied a Turkish F‑16 airstrike on its army positions after clashes with al-Shabaab, and US forces were accused of weaponising floods that trapped women and children. The conflict produced 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Hæren rapporterte et stort slag nær Buurhakaba-distriktet med dusinvis av sine soldater drept, samtidig som den hevdet å ha drept 75 al-Shabaab-krigere i samme område. Somalia avviste et tyrkisk F‑16‑luftangrep på sine hærposisjoner etter sammenstøt med al-Shabaab, og amerikanske styrker ble anklaget for å ha utnyttet flommer som fanget kvinner og barn. Konflikten førte til 2 284 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Ebola cases have surpassed 10,000 and a nurse treating patients was killed by a mob, while a health worker was wounded, prompting Uganda to tighten its border. Rebel forces continue to capture weapons from fleeing DRC and Burundian troops and the DRC army has recaptured strategic territory from a rebel group led by an ex-president. The conflict produced 1,158 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Opprørsstyrker fortsetter å ta våpen fra flyktende DRC‑ og burundiske tropper, og DRC-hæren har gjenerobret strategisk territorium fra en opprørsgruppe ledet av en tidligere president. En bombeeksplosjon nær grensen mellom Colombia og Venezuela såret minst fire politibetjenter, og et eksplosivangrep på samme grense såret seks, inkludert fire betjenter. To dødsfall knyttet til kamp ble registrert i 2007, ifølge UCDP.
